question: How long does a website project take?

children.text: The schedule depends on the size of your site and how ready your content is. We'll agree on the stages and timing before work begins.
Your proposal will set out the work, cost, and what's included. If your needs change, we'll discuss the impact before adding work.

question: What do you use to build websites?

children.text: We build with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Sanity. That gives you a custom website and a dedicated place to manage your content.
We work toward WCAG 2.2 AA through accessible design, semantic code, automated checks, and keyboard and screen-reader testing. Accessibility is part of the process, not a one-off score.

question: Can you help people find my website through search and AI tools?

children.text: We include clear page information, structured data, and technical search foundations. These help search and AI tools understand your business, but no one can guarantee rankings or citations.

question: What happens after my website launches?

children.text: We'll discuss handover and any ongoing support before launch, so you know who handles updates and what is included.
